ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a predominantly low-intensity (dark) central fluke body with high-intensity (white) patches localized on the distal lateral tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous areas are mapped to the outer 20-25% of each lobe's distal tips. The remainder of the fluke surface displays a complex mapping of low-intensity pixels interspersed with high-frequency white mottling and fine linear striations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and a vertical depth comprising roughly 10% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits high-frequency serration with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes. Notable deep indentations are visible on the medial portion of both the left and right lobes' trailing boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer margins of both lobes exhibit a concave curvature sweeping upwards and outwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-reflectance, three-dimensional geometric structures (barnacles) are concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches/rake marks) visible across the entire ventral surface, appearing as dark lines on white patches and light lines on dark regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on distal tips and numerous irregular notches along the trailing edge consistent with mechanical wear or prior trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplets are visible falling from both distal tips; small avian figures are present in the foreground and background water pixels.
